notes:
## Content
The opening equivalences lead to the faithful-stratification order/inclusion statement (92). The paragraph identifies the index set with a family of closed strata and adds local finiteness, nonemptiness, union X, the intersection condition (Strat 3), and the condition concerning smaller substrata. The proposed stronger expression for Strat 5 stops at “dans tt strate fermée.” Formula (93) defines X_J^* and X_J. A slanted framed NB states compatibility with unions and intersections.

## Reading decisions prompted by the mathematics
The nested indexed union prompted a prime check: both its index and its summand have one prime, not H's two. The nonempty condition has a literal closed 0, without a phi stem or slash. In the NB, the intersection identity is written with the two separate starred terms on the left. Both witnesses complete the following union identity, but the ink ends at X_{J\cup K}^*=X_J^*: the expected additional union term is absent and has not been supplied. These are reading checks, not proof verification.

## Slips, gaps and remaining doubts
There is no équivaut between “fidèle” and “à la donnée”; the resulting verbless wording remains. The singular words and abbreviation in “tt strate fermée.” remain, and the sentence is unfinished. The last NB identity is likewise left in its written incomplete form. Doubts remain in the joined closing delimiter of (92), the cancelled ens., tiny rec/rec., the mapping endpoint and several words in the cancelled final paragraph. The lower angular group beside the NB is accounted for once in the doubtful prose initial; a separate cancelled X_J^* cannot be distinguished from those shared strokes.

## Sheet
This is an unnumbered authorial text leaf, without a title or date. The visible formula labels are (92), with a joined/doubtful closing delimiter, and (93). The thin bottom-left 93 is later foliation and is preserved as a margin entry. The NB is enclosed by a hand-drawn text frame near (93); it is not a mathematical diagram. Its border crosses letters and the cancelled final prose but does not cancel the live note. The curved insertion leaders and the non-vides brace determine the attachments.
### Root targeted check of (92)

Using the disjoint partition into X_k^* from scan092, X_j is the union of X_k^* with k <= j. Under faithfulness, X_i^* is nonempty. If X_i^* is contained in X_j, a point of that stratum lies in one of the disjoint X_k^* with k <= j, so k=i and i <= j. The reverse implication follows from the indexing order, and X_i subset X_j implies X_i^* subset X_j. This checks both equivalences (92) and the ensuing order embedding. It does not justify completing the unfinished marginal union identity: the missing union X_K^* is absent from the ink and is removed from both witness readings. The paragraph after “Si on veut Strat 5” is also left unfinished. See CHECK_EVENTS statement150-094-order-embedding.
